Reason for Mistake: After encountering conflicting data on the English Wikipedia page (Step 5 showed “Los Angeles, California, USA”), WebSurfer re-opened the same page and reported a different value (“Rome, Lazio, Italy”) without investigating or reconciling the discrepancy. This inconsistent reporting and lack of authoritative verification is the first error that would lead to an incorrect or unresolved final answer.
